senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; שָׁקָה)drink, liquid. Sifra Sh’mini ch. IX, Par. 8 מ׳ זה היין ‘drink’ (Lev. XI, 34) means wine.
units: <cite ref="Leviticus 11:34">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ סרוח</he> spoiled liquid; <cite ref="Pesachim 18a:12">Pes. 18ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מַשְׁקִים</he>, <he>מַשְׁקִין</he>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 17b:12">Ib. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ הבאין מחמת ידים</he> liquids which have become unclean through contact with unclean hands.

<cite ref="Pesachim 17b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>שנטמאו מחמת מ׳</he> vessels which have become unclean through the liquids put into them; a. fr.—<he>מַשְׁקֵי בית מטבחיא</he>, v. <cite ref="M00963"><he>מַטְבָּחַיָּיא</he></cite> a. <cite ref="M00963"><he>מַדְבָּחַיָּיא</he></cite>.
